summary: Implementation plan to reorganize the app into 6 distinct navigation tabs (Home, Map, Mesh Radar, Community, Inbox, Profile). Declutters the Home screen by moving the Geohash Broadcast Composer and Intent Creation Grid into a dedicated 'Mesh Radar' screen (MeshRadarScreen.kt), ensuring a clean, spacious Home feed while maintaining active-only single-line label formatting (alwaysShowLabel = false) across all 6 bottom bar items.
